product.name: NurtureNest SecureView 200
product.description: The NurtureNest SecureView 200 is a compact wireless baby monitor designed for modern families. It streams high‑definition video and audio to a paired smartphone or tablet via Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth Low Energy, providing up to 120 minutes of battery life on a single charge. The monitor includes motion and temperature alerts, night‑vision infrared, and a two‑way intercom. Its ergonomic design fits comfortably on a nightstand, and the unit is constructed from durable ABS plastic with a soft-touch finish. The SecureView 200 offers a reliable, low‑maintenance solution for parents who want to keep an eye on their child from anywhere in the house.
